definitions.name: S0B.SUM
definitions.note: sum of a numeric Vector as a bare scalar

definitions.name: S0B.MEAN
definitions.note: arithmetic mean of a numeric Vector

definitions.name: S0B.DEV
definitions.note: Vector of each element minus the mean

definitions.name: S0B.MIN
definitions.note: smallest element of a Vector as a bare scalar

definitions.name: S0B.MAX
definitions.note: largest element of a Vector as a bare scalar

definitions.name: S0B.NORM
definitions.body: 'S0B.XS' BIND S0B.XS S0B.XS S0B.MIN - S0B.XS S0B.RANGE /

definitions.name: S0B.WORDS
definitions.note: split a String on single spaces into a Vector of words

definitions.name: S0B.TITLE
definitions.body: CHARS 'S0B.C' BIND S0B.C [ UPPER ] MAP S0B.C ' ' 1 COLLECT S0B.C -1 DROP CONCAT [ ' ' EQ ] MAP SELECT JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case every character that starts the String or follows a space

definitions.name: S0B.ACRONYM
definitions.body: S0B.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
definitions.note: upper-cased first letters of the space-separated words

definitions.name: S0B.LONGEST
definitions.note: length of the longest space-separated word

definitions.name: S0B.LONGWORDS
definitions.note: words longer than 3 characters, in order
